hotels.title: NSW: Tranquil Coastal Gerringong Resort with Onsite Restaurant, Bar & Three Pools
hotels.description: Experience coastal sophistication just moments from the rolling waves of Werri Beach, where lush hinterland meets the charm of Gerringong village. This refined retreat features spacious rooms with private balconies overlooking manicured gardens and three sparkling outdoor pools. Savour contemporary Australian cuisine at Bella Char Restaurant, or stroll to local favourites like The Hill Bar & Kitchen for ocean-view dining. Discover boutique wineries in the surrounding Shoalhaven region, or explore the dramatic cliffs and walking trails of nearby Seven Mile Beach National Park.
